title: AUDIT-7 Lane 7 slice C: forks + fleet open items stray-work pass (80 items)
body: Open items at AUDIT-7 census (2026-11-23): developing-today-forks/opencode 39, developing-today-forks/openchamber 32, dezren39/fleet 9. Labels stray-work / stray/needs-parent / audit-7 already created in all three repos. For each item, one by one, read in full incl. comments (per_page=100; lane claim = hard stop - lanes 2-4 own fork PR scopes; where another lane owns the item, record the linkage finding as a pointer comment on umbrella code#13871 instead of editing). Label stray items; link each to its parent in developing-today/code where one exists (opencode-platform epic, epic(openchamber) code#1234, fleet maintenance epic code#12460) via a comment on the item naming the parent, and a pointer comment on the parent. dezren39/fleet has only 15 labels and 106/113 window items unlabeled: apply the code-repo label taxonomy subset (kind/*, stray-work) to its 19 window issues.

payload.risk: low: label + sub-issue metadata only, no code changes, no closes
tests: readback via fleet gh api: parent sub_issues list contains child; child labels contain stray-work + primary-parent/*
